why: #722 moves googleapis/release-please-action from v4 to v5. Neither version declares outputs in action.yml. The action sets release_created and tag_name at run time. On 2026-10-06 the verifier blocked it because it counted those outputs as removed. It must ask only the decision about upstream changes that no local check can prove.
